ctx.x: There was one famous trombonist by the name of Williams. I never could find out if he's related. One of the brothers of Claiborne or son too. Is it Williamton? I can't think of his first name now. I know Roy Palmer told me about him, that he was inspired by him. And he traveled with Handy for a while. Johnny Handy? No, no. With W.C. Handy, the St. Louis Blues composer. Oh, St. Louis Blues, I see. He went up to Memphis. I'm not sure he was one of that family, but I always wondered. Well, I wouldn't know him. You…
I remember Williams played trombone. Oh, but Sam Williams, you know him? No. Sam Williams, he played trombone, but he used to be with Johnny Handy. Yeah, no other. And Kit Howard. Yeah. Clayton.
Did you know any of the members of the Claiborne Williams band by name at all? Do you remember any of the names that were in that band?
